items.apotheosis_things:salvaging_charm.desc.1: Automatically salvaging gear you pick up (if this gear can be salvaging)
items.apotheosis_things:salvaging_charm.desc.2: Doesn't salvaging gems or gear you've worn or held
items.apotheosis_things:salvaging_charm.desc.3: Combine with Rarity Material on the Anvil to set the highest rarity that can be automatically salvaging
items.apotheosis_things:salvaging_charm.desc.4: Current: salvaging gear of rarity of %s and below
items.apotheosis_things:transfer_charm.desc.1: Automatically transfer the gems or enchanted books you pick up to the Gem Case or Library
items.apotheosis_things:transfer_charm.desc.2: Hold this item and sneak and right-click on the Gem Case or Library to bind it
